scope: A compact, metadata-only research queue for Canadian offline spatial context, agricultural statistics, and university extension sources. It is not a download list, runtime corpus policy, spatial-pack manifest, rights grant, or model-training authorization.

admission_gates.title: Freeze one exact resource
admission_gates.purpose: Select the exact logical resource, record retrieval time, bytes, SHA-256, version and attribution, and preserve the raw resource outside Git before any derivation.

admission_gates.title: Confirm item-level reuse scope
admission_gates.purpose: Record the source-specific licence or written permission, attribution, commercial and redistribution scope, and third-party exclusions for the exact frozen bytes.

admission_gates.title: Make a separate training decision
admission_gates.purpose: Obtain and record a human-approved, source-specific training-use decision. General public availability or reuse language does not activate training.

admission_gates.title: Validate the compact derivative or extraction
admission_gates.purpose: Run a deterministic build with input/output hashes, schema checks, representative query tests, and a documented compactness budget.

admission_gates.title: Make a separate runtime admission
admission_gates.purpose: Add a reviewed runtime-policy decision only after all prior gates; candidate metadata cannot enter retrieval or field advice by itself.

admission_gates.title: Verify spatial semantics
admission_gates.purpose: Verify coordinate reference system, feature identifiers, boundary type, scale or temporal coverage, point-in-polygon behavior, and field-context limitations.

admission_gates.title: Select and validate published variables
admission_gates.purpose: Allowlist exact variables, units, geography, reference year, suppression codes, allocation method and aggregation limits before packaging statistics.

admission_gates.title: Review currency and agronomic scope
admission_gates.purpose: Check edition, regional calibration, intended crop or practice scope, label or regulatory currency, and the distinction between context and recommendation.

admission_gates.title: Exclude unlicensed third-party material
admission_gates.purpose: Identify co-authored, cited, embedded, photographed, table, logo, product-label, and publisher-controlled material before any copying or derivative creation.

candidate_sources.title: 2021 Census Boundary Files: provinces and territories (digital boundary selection)

source_characteristics.spatial_linkage: Province or territory identifier and census geographic identifiers; select only the digital province or territory boundary resource after exact-resource resolution.
source_characteristics.decision_role: Location label and jurisdiction routing context only.

rights.notes: The Statistics Canada licence is the observed publisher licence; the exact digital resource, attribution wording and any third-party exclusions still require a byte-level review.

training_rights.notes: No training-use decision has been made for the exact resource or any derivative.

limitations: An administrative boundary is not a farm, parcel, field, management zone, or legal boundary.
The catalogue offers cartographic and digital forms; the exact selection and its intended use must be recorded before derivation.
A point-in-polygon result labels geographic context and cannot establish agronomic suitability or a recommendation.

candidate_sources.title: 2021 Census Boundary Files: census agricultural regions (digital boundary selection)

source_characteristics.spatial_linkage: Census agricultural-region identifiers; select the exact digital CAR resource and join contract after exact-resource resolution.
source_characteristics.decision_role: Regional agricultural-statistics routing and context only.

rights.notes: The candidate shares the official boundary catalogue record with province and territory boundaries but needs its own selected-resource hash and geographic-join validation.

training_rights.notes: No training-use decision has been made for the exact resource or any derivative.

limitations: A census agricultural region is an aggregation geography, not a local management zone.
It must not be used to infer field practices, soil properties, yield, or input rates.
Any statistics joined through this geography require an explicit variable, year, unit, and suppression contract.

candidate_sources.title: Terrestrial Ecoregions of Canada, version 2.2

source_characteristics.spatial_linkage: Ecoregion polygon identifier after source-schema verification.
source_characteristics.decision_role: Broad ecological context and document-location routing only.

rights.notes: The official catalogue record displays the Open Government Licence - Canada. Exact-resource bytes, attribution and derivative scope still require the source-admission gates.

training_rights.notes: No training-use decision has been made for the source geometry, attributes, product specification, or a derivative.

limitations: An ecoregion describes broad regional ecological factors and cannot identify within-field conditions.
It is not a substitute for field observations, a soil test, weather records, pest surveillance, or a recommendation.
The reported source temporal coverage and maintenance status must travel with every derivative.

candidate_sources.title: Soil Landscapes of Canada, version 3.2

source_characteristics.content_type: national soil-landscape polygons linked to component and soil attribute tables
source_characteristics.spatial_linkage: Soil-landscape polygon and verified relational identifiers; retain only a review-approved compact attribute projection if later admitted.
source_characteristics.decision_role: Regional mapped-soil prior and source-document routing only.

rights.notes: The official catalogue record displays the Open Government Licence - Canada. No SLC bytes, table extracts, derived SQLite stores or other payloads are present in this registry.

training_rights.notes: No training-use decision has been made for the source data, its table joins, or a compact projection.

limitations: SLC is a mapped regional landscape product; it is not a current field soil sample or a prescription.
Component locations within a polygon are not established by a point-in-polygon result.
A compact derivative must preserve source version, polygon and component lineage, and the regional-prior boundary.

candidate_sources.title: Census of Agriculture: Agri-Environmental Spatial Data (AESD), 2021

source_characteristics.content_type: 2021 Census of Agriculture values spatially allocated to source geography
source_characteristics.spatial_linkage: Published AESD geography and a future allowlisted-variable contract; source documentation describes Soil Landscapes of Canada and sub-sub-drainage context.

rights.notes: The exact database resource and user guide have not been frozen or examined for variable-level, attribution, allocation-method, or third-party constraints.

training_rights.notes: No training-use decision has been made for published AESD values, source metadata, or derived context tables.

limitations: Spatial allocation and aggregate Census values are not farm observations, grower records, crop histories, or current field conditions.
No variable, unit, reference date, allocation method, suppression treatment or selected geography is approved yet.
Any later use must be context-only unless a separate, stronger authority is established.

candidate_sources.title: Census of Agriculture: Data Linked to Geographic Boundaries, 2021

source_characteristics.content_type: 2021 published Census of Agriculture statistics linked to standard geographic polygons
source_characteristics.spatial_linkage: Published province or territory, census agricultural region, census division and census consolidated subdivision geographies after exact table selection.
source_characteristics.decision_role: Aggregate historical agricultural context and regional coverage description only.

rights.notes: The catalogue record identifies five domains and explains that confidential values are assigned -1. Exact tables and source bytes have not been selected or assessed.

training_rights.notes: No training-use decision has been made for any Census of Agriculture table, geography, or derivative.

limitations: The record includes aggregate geography, not individual farms or fields.
The documented -1 confidential-value convention must be preserved and must never be treated as a measured value or zero.
Census reference year and geographic aggregation prevent present-tense field or management claims.

candidate_sources.title: 2021 Agricultural Ecumene Boundary File

source_characteristics.spatial_linkage: A future documented agricultural-ecumene feature identifier and published definition.
source_characteristics.decision_role: Broad display or routing mask candidate only.

rights.notes: Only the official catalogue identity is retained. A logical resource, its definition, bytes and resource-specific attribution have not been frozen.

training_rights.notes: No training-use decision has been made for the boundary or any derivative.

limitations: An agricultural ecumene is not proof that a particular parcel is farmed, crop-producing, eligible, or currently accessible.
It must not be used as a farm or field boundary.
Any visual use needs the source definition and reference year displayed or retained in provenance.

candidate_sources.title: MAKE Ag & Food Resources
candidate_sources.publisher: University of Manitoba, Faculty of Agricultural and Food Sciences

source_characteristics.content_type: university knowledge-exchange hub with crop resources, media and linked guidelines
source_characteristics.spatial_linkage: Manitoba and Prairie context claimed by individual resource metadata only; no geography is inferred from the hub page.
source_characteristics.decision_role: Discovery of candidate documents and research contacts only.

rights.licence_identifier: No source-specific reusable-content licence identified on the canonical hub page
rights.notes: The hub describes resources developed with Manitoba Pulse and Soybean Growers, Manitoba Agriculture and the University of Manitoba. Rights must be checked for each linked item and collaborator.

training_rights.notes: Public access to a hub or linked media is not treated as permission to use any item for model training.

limitations: The hub is an index, not one uniformly licensed or uniformly current source.
Collaborative guidelines require an item-level rights and attribution review.
A research or extension item cannot supply a current rate, threshold, product choice or regulatory answer without its own currency and authority check.

candidate_sources.title: Soils and Crops: Resources
candidate_sources.publisher: University of Saskatchewan, College of Agriculture and Bioresources

source_characteristics.content_type: university workshop proceedings and research-resource hub
source_characteristics.spatial_linkage: Saskatchewan or Prairie applicability must be established from each authored item, study setting and date.
source_characteristics.decision_role: Research discovery and document-level candidate intake only.

rights.licence_identifier: No source-specific reusable-content licence identified on the canonical resource page
rights.notes: The hub includes proceedings and authored materials. Copyright, author permission, edition, and applicability must be determined item by item.

training_rights.notes: A publicly downloadable proceeding is not treated as a training-data authorization.

limitations: Conference proceedings and research updates may be historical, preliminary, or narrower than general extension guidance.
Authorship, study location, units, methods and version must be retained before the item can support a contextual statement.
No source in this hub is an automatic recommendation or pesticide-label authority.

candidate_sources.title: Field Crop News
candidate_sources.publisher: Ontario Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs; University of Guelph; Ontario field crop collaborators

source_characteristics.content_type: Ontario field-crop extension and research article archive
source_characteristics.spatial_linkage: Ontario relevance and any regional qualifier must be assessed for each article, publication date and cited source.
source_characteristics.decision_role: Current-source discovery and individual-article candidate intake only.

rights.licence_identifier: No source-specific reusable-content licence identified on the canonical about page
rights.notes: The about page identifies a collaboration among provincial staff, university faculty and producers. This metadata does not establish rights to individual articles, images, tables, embedded documents or quoted sources.

training_rights.notes: No archive-wide or article-level training permission has been obtained or inferred.

limitations: The archive contains time-sensitive material and cannot be treated as a timeless field recommendation source.
Pesticide, product, pest and regulatory content require the current official authority and product label where applicable.
Regional applicability cannot be inferred from Ontario-wide publisher identity alone.

candidate_sources.title: Wild Blueberry Network Information Centre: Fact Sheets

source_characteristics.content_type: university specialty-crop publication and fact-sheet hub
source_characteristics.spatial_linkage: Atlantic applicability, crop system and source version must be recorded for each fact sheet or linked report.
source_characteristics.decision_role: Specialty-crop source discovery and item-level candidate intake only.

rights.licence_identifier: No source-specific reusable-content licence identified on the canonical fact-sheet page
rights.notes: The publication site aggregates full-text resources and citations, which can include historical documents and material owned by other organizations.

training_rights.notes: No training-use permission has been requested or inferred for the hub, individual fact sheets, linked reports or cited sources.

limitations: This is a specialty-crop hub and must not be generalized to unrelated crops or regions.
Historical fact sheets, pest material and linked external documents need individual date, rights and current-label review.
A source's presence on a university publication page does not establish recommendation, distribution or training rights.
